messages.content: QuoteCraft is a quoting app for contractors: quotes built from line items and a service catalog, exported as a PDF and sent by email, with clients, a status lifecycle and expiry reminders. It runs local-first on an encrypted SQLite database.

QuoteCraft is an Uno Platform single-project app (Uno.Sdk 7.0.0-dev.115, pinned in global.json) at QuoteCraft/QuoteCraft.csproj. The unit tests live in the development repository, noknowscode/QuoteCraft. Heads: net10.0-desktop, net10.0-browserwasm, net10.0-android, net10.0-ios and net10.0-windows10.0.19041 (WinAppSDK, x64 and ARM64); the SDK skips the heads the build OS cannot build.

**Key files:**
- QuoteCraft/App.xaml.cs: the host (logging, configuration with the optional Supabase section, DI registrations, navigation, the theme service) and the route map: Shell, then Main with the Dashboard (quotes), Clients, Catalog and Settings tabs; Dashboard holds a nested ./QuoteDetail region; QuoteEditor sits beside the tabs; Onboarding, Auth, the Notifications drawer and the dialogs are routes under Shell. App.Verification.cs holds Debug-only command-line hooks.
- QuoteCraft/Presentation: one MVUX partial-record model per page (DashboardModel the list, QuoteDetailModel the open quote, QuoteEditorModel, ClientsModel, CatalogModel, SettingsModel with AccountSettingsModel and ThemeSettingsModel, OnboardingModel, AuthModel, MainModel, NotificationsModel). Page code-behind is InitializeComponent only.
- QuoteCraft/Presentation/Dialogs: every dialog is a XAML ContentDialog with a model, registered as a DataViewMap or ResultDataViewMap and opened from a model with the "!" qualifier (Helpers/DialogNavigation: Confirm, NewQuote, SendQuote, LineItemEditor, CatalogBrowser, ClientEditor, CatalogItemEditor, PhotoViewer). Form dialogs keep their buttons in the content so the model validates before it closes them with NavigateBackWithResultAsync.
- QuoteCraft/Services: QuoteCreationService (every new quote), QuoteStatusService (status rules, history, expiry), QuoteExpiryService (expiry and 3-day reminders every 5 minutes), QuoteDelivery (a quote as it goes out: read, PDF, email), QuoteBoard (which quote is open, and that quotes changed, shared by the list and the detail), PdfGenerator (SkiaSharp SKDocument, US Letter, DM Sans from the package), ShareService (PDF delivery per head), CurrencyService, NotificationService, FeatureGateService; AuthService, SubscriptionService and SyncService for the optional cloud mode.
- QuoteCraft/Data: AppDatabase (SQLCipher through Microsoft.Data.Sqlite and SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlcipher, migrations, the seeded 65-item catalog) and one repository per table; Data/Remote has the Supabase client and settings.
- QuoteCraft/Styles: ColorPaletteOverride.xaml (Material roles), BrandColors.xaml, StatusColors.xaml, Cards.xaml (CardContentControl styles) and Layout.xaml (spacing, insets, widths, radii and the SplitLayout breakpoint at 1400). Pages carry no hex colours and no literal spacing.

**Patterns and traps:**
- MVUX pages bind with {Binding}. A FeedView needs a record or list feed: IState<string> messages and IFeed<int> counts bind directly. Error templates reach Retry by ElementName (their DataContext is the exception). Bool to Visibility goes through BoolToVisibilityConverter.
- Helpers/WholeFeedViewStateSelector (in the implicit FeedView style in App.xaml) sets the data, error and progress states on every message; without it a reopened tab could keep an old error template over new data.
- Text fields bind with UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged so a toolbar Save (which takes no focus) sees the last edit.
- Money lives in Helpers/Money: decimal amounts, tax rounded once to the cent, half away from zero; rates kept as typed.
- Responsive: utu:Responsive on the Toolkit's breakpoints (bottom tabs below 800, a side rail from 800, list and detail side by side from 1080, side columns from 1400). Material theme, Light, Dark or System through IThemeService.
- A quote's valid-until date is set in the editor (default from Settings) and stored as the end of the picked day in UTC; sending keeps a date that is ahead (docs/DECISIONS-production-readiness.md, D20).

**Services and what is optional:**
- Local-first: with no Supabase URL and anon key (appsettings.json or QUOTECRAFT_SUPABASE_URL and QUOTECRAFT_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) there is no account, no plan limits and no watermark, and Settings says the data stays on the device. With a project, Settings offers Sign In and the Stripe plans; cloud sync stays off (D8).
- WebAssembly keeps the database in IndexedDB (IDBFS) without encryption; desktop keeps the database key in a file; Android, iOS and WinAppSDK keep it in PasswordVault (D1, D13).
- Email opens the device's mail app through a mailto link; the PDF is attached by hand.

**Build:**
- dotnet build QuoteCraft/QuoteCraft.csproj -f net10.0-desktop, then dotnet run with the same arguments.
- Warnings are errors (Directory.Build.props). Debug hooks: --qc-data=<folder>, --qc-seed=sample, --qc-theme=light|dark, --qc-route=<route>[:detail], --qc-focus=log, --qc-fault=load.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
